user.title: Choose a BILRESA rotary remote
user.description: Pair the remote with Home Assistant Matter first. Each entry controls one group.

settings.title: Light controls
settings.description: Configure this remote group. Repeat Add integration to configure another group or remote.

data.brighten_from_off: Allow turning up to switch lights on
data.temperature_steps: Temperature presets in kelvin, separated by commas

data_description.lights: Choose any HA light entities. Light groups are expanded into their members. Dimming needs dimmable lights; temperature cycling needs white-temperature support.
data_description.step_percent: 3% is close to 8/255 per wheel step.
data_description.lit_only: Preserve bulbs that are off when some selected lights are already on.
data_description.brighten_from_off: Start from a low brightness when all selected dimmable lights are off.
data_description.brightness_transition: 0 seconds gives the most direct scroll response.
data_description.temperature_steps: Use 2–16 increasing values. Each light is limited to its supported range.
data_description.temperature_follows_brightness: White follows brightness up to the chosen Kelvin limit. Selected colors keep their saturation and shift gently warmer when dimmed, cooler when brightened.
data_description.brightness_max_kelvin: Limited to each bulb’s supported range. White-only bulbs beside colored lights use complementary white instead.

error.remote_missing: The selected remote is no longer available in Matter.
error.group_missing: The remote does not expose that group.
error.lights_required: Select at least one light entity.
error.invalid_settings: Check the selected settings and allowed number ranges.
error.brightness_range: Minimum brightness must not exceed maximum brightness.
error.temperature_steps: Enter 2–16 increasing whole-number temperatures from 1000 to 12000 K.

abort.no_remotes: No paired BILRESA rotary remotes were found. Set up Home Assistant Matter, pair the remote, and wait for its endpoints to load.
abort.already_configured: This remote group already has a BILRESA Dial configuration.
